quests.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
quests.objective: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
quests.description: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads and 1 Ogre Tannin (basket on the upper level beyond Knot). Make any suits and learn the pattern before freeing Knot, because he leaves.

quests.name: Free Knot!
quests.objective: Find a Gordok Shackle Key on the ogres of the Gordok wing and use it to free Knot Thimblejack.
quests.description: Get a Gordok Shackle Key from the North ogres and free Knot; his cache has loot.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.objective: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.
quests.description: Interact with the Skeletal Remains of Telmius Dreamseeker beside Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum. Unlocks Lydros's libram exchanges.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.objective: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.
quests.description: Interact with the Skeletal Remains of Telmius Dreamseeker beside Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum. Unlocks Lydros's libram exchanges.

quests.name: Libram of Rapidity
quests.objective: Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.
quests.description: Repeatable. Needs your faction's Elven Legends turned in first.

quests.name: Libram of Focus
quests.objective: Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.
quests.description: Repeatable. Needs your faction's Elven Legends turned in first.

quests.name: Libram of Protection
quests.objective: Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.
quests.description: Repeatable. Needs your faction's Elven Legends turned in first.

quests.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
quests.objective: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul. According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
quests.description: West objective: the Gauntlet of Gordok Might is in a chest near Prince Tortheldrin. The quest itself comes from a friendly Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul North after you become the Gordok king.
